🔥 बॉक्स ऑफिस पर आने वाली है तबाही या ठंडी रहेगी शुरुआत?

डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari की फिल्म Ramayana की रिलीज में अब सिर्फ 3.5 दिन बाकी हैं।
1 नवंबर 2026 शाम 5 बजे तक फिल्म ने भारत में Day 1 एडवांस बुकिंग में 20.15 करोड़ gross का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है।
फिल्म के 13,256 active shows में 4.54 लाख से ज्यादा टिकट बिक चुके हैं और ये 2026 की तीसरी सबसे बड़ी एडवांस बुकिंग है।
लेटेस्ट रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक ये फिल्म Dhurandhar 2 (53 करोड़) और Drishyam 3 (31.65 करोड़) से पीछे है।
कर्नाटक में Yash के दम पर सबसे ज्यादा 3.96 करोड़ gross हुआ है और बेंगलुरु अकेले 3.11 करोड़ के साथ टॉप पर है।
पूरे देश में 42 houseful shows हुए हैं जिनमें अकेले Telangana में 22 और Gujarat में 11 शो हाउसफुल हैं।
क्या Ramayana बॉक्स ऑफिस के सारे पुराने रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? 🎬

ctx.summary:
Final leg of advance booking for Ramayana's opening day is clearly being ruled by Karnataka with Yash's dominance - day 1 advance booking report. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (4 Days To Go): 42 Houseful Shows, With 4.5 Lakh Sold Tickets – Yash’s Dominance Visible In Pre-Sales!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The pre-release momentum for director Nitesh Tiwari’s magnum opus Ramayana featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi has officially entered its final countdown phase. With roughly 3.5 days remaining before its worldwide release on November 5 (Diwali 2026), the advance booking numbers have hit an important emotional benchmark, yet the buzz remains tamed!
As per the latest updates, till November 1, 2026, 5 PM, Ramayana has officially crossed the 20.15 crore gross mark (excluding blocked seats) for its Day 1 pre-sales in India. Selling over 4.54 lakh tickets excluding blocked seats across 13,256 active shows, the film firmly holds the #3 spot on Bollywood’s top Day 1 advance grossers of 2026.
However, when pitted against astronomical expectations, the film is yet to trigger the kind of destructive mass rampage seen with recent benchmark openers like Dhurandhar 2 ( 53 crore ) and Drishyam 3 ( 31.65 crore ).
Take a look at Bollywood’s top day 1 advance bookings of 2026 in India (gross):
While crossing 20 crore gross in pre-sales and the 17 crore mark in net collection with the advance booking for the opening day, Ramayana is already the sixth biggest opener of Ranbir Kapoor’s career.
Karnataka takes the crown, crossing the 3.96 crore gross mark driven by massive local fan frenzy for Yash (playing Ravana). The state has overtaken all domestic territories, with 78,500 tickets sold. Meanwhile, Bengaluru, with a 3.11 crore gross collection, remains the undisputed top city in India, accounting for 52,620 tickets across multi-language formats. Telangana & Gujarat lead Houseful spikes. Out of 42 houseful shows across the country, Telangana commands 22 sold-out shows, followed closely by Gujarat with 11 houseful counters.
